ads.title: T1 Coordination · Variation A
ads.primary_text:
You have spent years building each piece of your financial life. Is every piece working together?

Investments, taxes, estate planning, and the timing of your retirement each affect the others, yet they are often managed apart. Confluence coordinates them into a single strategy, reviewed by a fiduciary team of Wealth Managers and Certified Financial Planners®.

We would value the opportunity to understand your situation. Request a consultation for an initial conversation, with no obligation.

Confluence Wealth Services, Inc. d/b/a Confluence Financial Partners is an SEC-registered investment adviser.

ads.title: T2 Second Opinion · Variation B
ads.primary_text:
Many of the individuals and families we serve came to us after years with another advisor. Often, they simply wanted a second perspective.

A change of advisor is rarely the reason. More often, a financial life has grown complex enough, across multiple advisors and holdings, that a coordinated review brings a welcome clarity. Our fiduciary team offers that outside view.

If that is a conversation worth having, request a consultation, with no obligation.

Confluence Wealth Services, Inc. d/b/a Confluence Financial Partners is an SEC-registered investment adviser.

As retirement, a relocation, or a change in the family draws closer, the questions multiply, and the answers rarely sit in one place. Our fiduciary team of Wealth Managers and Certified Financial Planners® helps coordinate each piece into a single plan built around where you are headed.

When the time feels right, request a consultation, with no obligation.

Confluence Wealth Services, Inc. d/b/a Confluence Financial Partners is an SEC-registered investment adviser.
